findings.description: save_etag() calls fwrite()/fputc() whose return values are not checked (and (void)-casts fflush()), while the sibling ftruncate()/fseek() call in the same function IS checked and returns CURL_WRITEFUNC_ERROR on failure. Intra-function return-path asymmetry: the write result is absorbed.

adjudication.note: Reproduced on stock curl 8.19.0 (built from source): a RLIMIT_FSIZE=0 write failure leaves the --etag-save file empty while curl exits 0. Fix verified in the paired patch cleanroom (curl: (23), exit 23; happy path unchanged).
